Young Ember Drake (CV 29)

A young, broad-winged dragon with warm red scales, a heavy jaw and smoke-darkened nostrils. Possessiveness has developed faster than judgment or experience.

Attributes: Brawn +2; Fortitude +2; Agility +1; Guile +0; Knowledge +0; Reason +1

HP: 28 · Speed: 6; fly 8 · Size: 2 (2x2 squares) · Armor DR: 1*

Evasion: None · Threat: 1 Bane · Stability: 1

Weaknesses: None\ Resistances: Physical (1), Fire (3)\ Immunities: None

Actions

Damage and effects are Weak / Standard / Strong player defense. Each slash separates one complete outcome. All attacks use the printed Threat unless stated otherwise.

Details

Hot jaws

Target: One adjacent creature. Player defense: Agility. Damage type: physical.

Ember breath

Its chest swells and light leaks between its teeth; there is one terrible instant to scatter.

Target: All creatures in a cone of 3 rows, 1/3/5 squares wide. Player defense: Agility. Damage type: fire.

Weak defense: Burning 2. Standard defense: Burning 1.

Limit: Cannot use this attack on consecutive turns, regardless of result.

Claw rake

The drake slashes across the target rather than committing its head.

Target: One adjacent creature. Player defense: Agility. Damage type: physical.

Weak defense: Bleeding 2. Standard defense: Bleeding 1.

Stoke the Core

Coals brighten inside its body and a hot breath spills between teeth or iron seams.

Add 1 Fire damage to its next damaging Main Action attack before the end of this turn. Apply it once per target damaged by that attack, using the normal mixed-damage resistance and minimum rules. This grants no extra attack or Burning. Repeated uses do not add more Fire damage.

Wing Step

A single hard wingbeat carries it toward a better angle.

Move up to 2 squares using its printed fly speed without provoking from one visible enemy chosen before moving. Pay normal terrain costs and provoke normally from other enemies. This grants no attack, automatic lift of another creature or hovering exception.

General details

Basic Melee: One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses the printed Threat. No specialty riders.

Defend: Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until the start of its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules. Repeated Defend does not stack.

Opportunity Attack: Basic Melee against the provoking creature. Spends its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if the creature remains capable.

Heavy Frame — Passive: Stability 1; an explicit creature trait, not a bonus from size.

Healing: Living: ordinary HP healing applies.

Senses: Ordinary sight and hearing.

Signs: Fresh scorch marks surround a pile of shiny scrap.

Purpose: Build a hoard and prove ownership of a hunting ground.

Tactics and retreat: Breathe along a close approach, then bite while its breath recovers.

Counterplay and conversation: Spread out, use stone cover, and negotiate over a specific object it wants.

Habitat: Rocky hill; ruined tower · Communication: Understands Draconic; speaks short phrases

Loot: One shared hoard of 60 coins and ordinary trade goods.

Summoning: Ineligible.

Design notes — not needed during play

ID: creature-young-ember-drake

Category: Dragon · Role: Flying artillery · CV: 29

CV worksheet

Difficulty rationale: No innate attack modifier; armor, cover and chosen actions provide its defenses. Its dangerous attack imposes defense Banes.

Reference damage: 3/5/7

Reference type: physical

Expected targets: 1

Utility factor: 1.65

Action review (#1279): U 1.55 → 1.65: Maneuver allowance +0.1, Reaction allowance +0. These are provisional judgments for the changed capabilities, counting the largest increment in each category rather than adding every alternative. Reactions compete for one budget; no measured balance claim.

Regeneration per turn: 0

Reference I=4.000, O=4.596. CV uses the seed worksheet; action choices, Stability and control are not simulated. Recalibration remains required.
